# Acorn House Acquisition

> We buy houses for cash in North Carolina and Florida, as-is and in any condition. No repairs, no commissions, and we pay the normal closing costs. Written cash offer within 24 hours; close in as little as 7 days.

Acorn House Acquisition LLC is a real estate investment company that buys residential properties directly from homeowners. We are not a licensed real estate brokerage. Every sale closes through a licensed title company or closing attorney.

- Phone: (786) 982-8464
- Email: info@acornhouseacquisition.com
- NC office: 19825-B North Cove Rd #1041, Cornelius, NC 28031
- FL office: 5342 Clark Rd #1273, Sarasota, FL 34233

## Situations we help with

- Cash purchases, as-is, any condition
- Foreclosure: we can often close before the auction date
- Inherited and probate homes
- Landlords with damaged rentals or problem tenants
- Divorce sales
- Little or no equity (subject-to purchases)

## How it works

1. Call (786) 982-8464 or fill out the form on the website.
2. We review the property and send a written, no-obligation cash offer within 24 hours.
3. You pick the closing date, as soon as 7 days out. We close through a licensed title company.
